{{Top|leg}}
The '''SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY''' was interrupted by the crash landing of a stolen prototype, a radiation storm and an argument between the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and the [[Metatheran Cartel]].

==History==
Every year, the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] held a celebration to commemorate the first production of first [[G-59 Cannibalizer|Cannibalizer]] production in the [[Edic Bar]] facility.<ref name="Celebrate SoroSuub">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20021127scenario|text=Celebrate SoroSuub}}</ref>

In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], a party of heroes infiltrated the ''[[Conkesta]]'', a flying fortress created by a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|dark Jedi]] and hidden near the planetary core. The heroes destroyed the ''Conkesta'' and escaped in a prototype ship stolen from SoroSuub. The ship was damaged in the escape and they crash-landed in the party. SoroSuub executives recognized the stolen model and offered a reward for her. The heroes's ally [[Alec (Jedi)|Alec]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] offered them a honor reception with authorities from Genarius and [[Almas]].<ref name="itsc">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds}}</ref>

Later during the party, the celebration almost became a disaster when a [[Radiation/Legends|radiation storm]] swept over the floating city, knocking out the city's shields. Other damage threatened to sent the city plunging into the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Genarius]] far below. Only rapid action by a number of heroes managed to avert this crash.<ref name="Blown Away B">''[[Blown Away]]'' (as described in [https://web.archive.org/web/20021221113407/www.wizards.com/rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20010913b_interactive&c=swlfc RPGA Living Force Interactive] on the [[Wikipedia:Internet_Archive#Wayback_Machine|Wayback Machine]])</ref> Scholar of Jedi lore and witness of the storm, [[Dazen Mok]] later theorized that the ''Conkesta'', created by a dark Jedi, was strong in the dark side and so was the core of Genarius, so the destruction of the fortress might have created the storm.<ref name="tons">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040408|text=Tales of Nub Saar}}</ref>

The celebration was also marred by a public argument between [[Miim Te'Suub]] of the SoroSuub Corporation and [[Thurm Loogg]] of the [[Metatheran Cartel]]. Te'Suub had taken offense to the Cartel overlaying his annual speech with their logo, and [[Jedi Consular]]s were required to resolve the dispute before it turned to violence. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kurth San]] of the [[Thaereian military]] used to party to value the interest talented individuals might have in joining his army.<ref name="Blown Away A">''[[Blown Away]]'' (as described in [https://web.archive.org/web/20021218152817/www.wizards.com/rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20010927b_transmissions&c=swlfc Transmissions From the Living Force Campaign] on the [[Wikipedia:Internet Archive#Wayback machine|Way back machine]])</ref>

At the end of the celebration, SoroSuub gratefully gave one of the helping pilots a prototype SoroSuub [[RK-720 Light Freighter]], the ''[[Sivulliq]]''.<ref name="Blown Away A" />
